purpose: Source provenance triage for real human twilight star visibility, not a dusk first-NO/first-YES benchmark

primary_publisher_book.author: Rumen Kolev
primary_publisher_book.title: The Babylonian Astrolabe: The Calendar of Creation
primary_publisher_book.series: State Archives of Assyria Studies XXII
primary_publisher_book.section: Appendix: Heliacal Practice, reported pages 237-263 by independent reviewer
primary_publisher_book.publisher_claim: Appendixes include 255 first-hand observations of heliacal phases of stars and planets
primary_publisher_book.availability: Bibliographic listing verified; exact full appendix entries not acquired; no paid acquisition

primary_2001.author: Rumen Kolev
primary_2001.title: Witnessing the Heliacal Rise of Sirius and Procyon
primary_2001.journal: Journal for the History of Astronomy

primary_2007.author: Rumen Kolev
primary_2007.title: Six Observations of the Heliacal Rise of Sirius
primary_2007.journal: Journal for the History of Astronomy

secondary_review.author: Victor Reijs
secondary_review.description: Secondary quotation/analysis of Kolev's visible onset UTC and duration, errors and extinction-coefficient adjustments; not original per-entry record custody
secondary_review.caution: Reijs adjusted AEC to match observed events in his Schaefer comparison; matching predictions are in-sample, not independent validation

scientific_type_boundary.heliacal_morning_first: First seasonal emergence before sunrise as Sun approaches horizon; not an evening first star seen after sunset
scientific_type_boundary.heliacal_evening_last: Final seasonal visibility in evening, not last-NO/first-YES of dusk emergence
scientific_type_boundary.counts: Publisher 255 includes mixed star/planet and heliacal phase types, not 255 independent usable star-first-event brackets
scientific_type_boundary.secondary_measurement: Time snippets reproduced as secondary quotations are useful leads but do not supply publisher-original logged first-NO, unaided-eye classification, directional sky radiance, instrument provenance, or meteorological source
scientific_type_boundary.extinction: AEC reported in a downstream table can be fitted by a secondary model; do not claim contemporaneous measured aerosols/AOD
scientific_type_boundary.no_access: Do not infer unpublished adaptation, cloud, observer, horizon, moon or AOD fields

fixed_source_acquisition_plan.limit: One source acquisition attempt for original 2001 and/or 2007 article under lawful publisher/library access, and separate locate Appendix F source pages 237-263 if openly and lawfully accessible; no purchase, no personal data, no unbounded search
fixed_source_acquisition_plan.capture: Record exact original page/table, author event and instrument/observer protocol; source SHA256 only after actual bytes acquired and checked; distinguish original text vs secondary transcription
fixed_source_acquisition_plan.no_imputation: When source not accessible or original lacks weather/adaptation/NO logs, return explicit unsupported; do not fill defaults
fixed_source_acquisition_plan.separate_prospective_pilot: Continue V0 pre-registered first-NO/first-YES volunteer study with exact prediction lock before data as in issue #152 comment 6732773202
fixed_source_acquisition_plan.model_release: No promotion, no MYSTIC dispatch, no Taylor/Jerusalem holdout opening; 10.5-16deg first-visibility UNSUPPORTED/null, >16deg OOD
